name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jikentan 'Rasen no Hitsugi Satsujin Jiken'
original_name: 探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚「螺旋の棺殺人事件」
source:
The members of the Kibukawa Detective Agency take on the challenge of a series of mysterious deaths of a certain large company executive and a series of bank robberies.

Masao Ikurumi comes across the scene of a case where a famous company executive in Marihama City, K Prefecture, was poisoned, and together with Izuna Sagishima, he searches for the truth behind the case.

Meanwhile, Detective Kurogane is chasing a serial bank robber in T Prefecture. An investigation begins at the audition venue for the theater troupe Moonlight Brigade, which is about to perform...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
癸生川侦探事务所的成员们，将挑战某大型企业高管接连离奇死亡的案件，以及一系列银行劫案。

在K县鞠滨市，一位知名企业高管遭人毒杀。生王正生偶然来到案发现场，与白鹭洲伊纲一同追查真相。

另一方面，黑金刑警正在T县追捕一名连环银行劫匪。一场调查，在即将上演剧目的剧团“月光旅团”试镜会场展开……
